items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think before Andy came in, you were telling about when you played up the roof garden and Fates band.

ctx.x: No, Harvey Lightfoot. Harvey Lightfoot. Yeah, that's his name. He's on record, too. Yeah. Harvey, wait. Is he still living? I don't know. Harvey Lightfoot. Mm-hmm. And he had a drummer. What's his drummer name? He live in Chicago. Now, a singing drummer. He sings well. Camel. Oh, yes. Camel. Floyd. That's right. Floyd Camel. That's right. He on piano. And, uh, what's this trombone player name? Natty Dominic? Nat, Nat, Nat, Nat. Nat, Nat. A trombone. Fine trombone. That's him. That's right. That story. St. Louis.…
I think before Andy came in, you were telling about when you played up the roof garden and Fates band.
Did they have two bands that were lights? Two bands. Two bands. Yeah. They had a better band. A fine band.
